            *   Elena busy list: does not contain 15:30. FREE.

    *   It seems I am making a mistake in my manual check. There must be a slot. Let me re-read everything very carefully.

        *   Tue: 09:00, 09:30 (I found Elena/David free) -> Priya & Marcus are both busy.
        *   Wed: 13:00, 13:30 (I found Elena/David free) -> Priya & Marcus are both busy.

    *   30-minute meeting.
    *   Next week: Mon, Nov 16 to Fri, Nov 20, 2026, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern.
    *   The data provided by Alison is the only source for Priya/Marcus.
    *   The data from `read_calendar` is the only source for Elena/David.
    *   The calendars list BUSY times. Any time not listed is FREE.

        *   Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
        *   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
